company: M. K. Sons Fine Jewels Limited
business_stage: Early scaling (5 showrooms, expanding with issue-funded inventory)

anchor.source: Anchor bidding 27-Oct-2026 (one working day before opening); allocation report not reachable

flags: AMBER: DCF and relative diverge by -41.1% - the divergence is the finding; name its cause
RED: objects floor sits above blended fair value
AMBER: TV above 75% of EV - DCF is mostly a terminal guess
model.reverse_dcf: The price asks the business to deliver 47.2 times its current free cash flow, in perpetuity.

call_basis: Call rule (ROUTINE.md hard rule 6), judged at the Rs 162 upper band: Neutral value Rs 120 is 26.2% below (within 10-30%), so the call is Neutral. No material issue was found. Figures are from the DRHP because the RHP was not reachable.
reference_note: Upper band Rs 162 (NSE issue page). At Rs 162: market cap Rs 911.9 cr post-issue; P/E 23.4x on 9M FY26 PAT annualised (39.2x on FY25, before a full year of the merged business); P/B 2.49x post-issue; EV/EBITDA 11.8x annualised. Objects floor Rs 133.46.
headline: A fast-growing Mumbai-Ahmedabad jewellery retailer (5 showrooms, 13% EBITDA margin) raising Rs 220 cr of fresh money to stock new showrooms, priced at 23x annualised earnings against a 22x peer median; our fair value is Rs 120 (Neutral) because inventory-heavy growth leaves little free cash flow.
red_flags: Revenue Rs 217.32 cr (FY24) -> Rs 351.28 cr (FY25) -> Rs 360.82 cr in 9M FY26; EBITDA margin 5.9% -> 11.0% -> 13.4%, helped by rising gold prices (pp. 101, 227)
Inventory Rs 240.59 cr (205 days); operating cash flow negative FY23-25, +Rs 18.01 cr in 9M FY26; no gold hedging disclosed (pp. 101, 226, 228)
Promoter's proprietorship merged in Mar-2025 for 40.38 lakh shares (Rs 71.07 cr); Rs 21.52 cr of FY25 purchases from it before the merger (pp. 64, 189)
Ahmedabad showrooms 62.40% of 9M FY26 revenue; five showrooms in two cities (pp. 23, 91)
RHP not reachable: DRHP (May-2026) figures used; fair value Rs 103 / 120 / 141 vs Rs 162

strengths: Revenue up from Rs 24.91 cr to Rs 351.28 cr in two years (p. 227)
EBITDA margin 13.36% and ROCE 26.84% in 9M FY26 (p. 101)
weaknesses: Short history as a combined entity (p. 189)
Young board; promoter family about 100% pre-issue (pp. 65-66, 78)
opportunities: New Maharashtra and expanded Ahmedabad showrooms in FY27 (p. 91)
Shift to organised hallmarked jewellery (p. 111 onwards)
threats: National chains in Mumbai and Ahmedabad (p. 100)
